violatedPolicies.name: Container using read-write root filesystem
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with containers with read-write root filesystem
violation: Container 'nginx' uses a read-write root filesystem
violatedPolicies.remediation: Use a read-only root filesystem, and use volume mounts to allow writes to specific sub-directories depending on your application's needs.

violatedPolicies.name: Container with privilege escalation allowed
violatedPolicies.description: Alerts if a deployment has containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation set to true in its security context.
violation: Container 'nginx' allows privilege escalation
violatedPolicies.remediation: Verify that privileged escalation is required and cannot be provided with a subset of other controls. Disable privilege escalation by setting allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

violatedPolicies.name: Pod Service Account Token Automatically Mounted
violatedPolicies.description: Protect pod default service account tokens from compromise by minimizing the mounting of the default service account token to only those pods whose application requires interaction with the Kubernetes API.
violation: Deployment mounts the service account tokens.
Namespace has name 'isaac-sim-streaming'
Service Account is set to 'default'
violatedPolicies.remediation: Add `automountServiceAccountToken: false` or a value distinct from 'default' for the `serviceAccountName` key to the deployment's Pod configuration.

violatedPolicies.name: Drop All Capabilities
violatedPolicies.description: Alert when a deployment does not drop all capabilities.
violation: Container 'nginx' does not drop expected capabilities (drops no capabilities)
violatedPolicies.remediation: Ensure that the deployment manifest has `drop: ALL` in the securityContext section of the container manifest.

violatedPolicies.name: Red Hat Package Manager in Image
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with components of the Red Hat/Fedora/CentOS package management system.
violation: Container 'nginx' includes component 'dnf' (version 4.14.0-31.el9)

violatedPolicies.remediation: Run `rpm -e --nodeps $(rpm -qa '*rpm*' '*dnf*' '*libsolv*' '*hawkey*' 'yum*')` in the image build for production containers.

violatedPolicies.name: Container using read-write root filesystem
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with containers with read-write root filesystem
violation: Container 'isaac-sim' uses a read-write root filesystem
Container 'tls-proxy' uses a read-write root filesystem
violatedPolicies.remediation: Use a read-only root filesystem, and use volume mounts to allow writes to specific sub-directories depending on your application's needs.

violatedPolicies.name: Container with privilege escalation allowed
violatedPolicies.description: Alerts if a deployment has containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation set to true in its security context.
violation: Container 'isaac-sim' allows privilege escalation
Container 'tls-proxy' allows privilege escalation
violatedPolicies.remediation: Verify that privileged escalation is required and cannot be provided with a subset of other controls. Disable privilege escalation by setting allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

violatedPolicies.name: 90-Day Image Age
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with images that haven't been updated in 90 days
violation: Container 'tls-proxy' has image created at 2025-04-16 14:50:31 (UTC)
violatedPolicies.remediation: Rebuild your image, push a new minor version (with a new immutable tag), and update your service to use it.

violatedPolicies.name: ADD Command used instead of COPY
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments using an ADD command
violation: Dockerfile line 'ADD alpine-minirootfs-3.21.3-x86_64....' found in container 'tls-proxy'
Dockerfile line 'ADD file:ddf1aa62235de6657123492b19d...' found in container 'isaac-sim'
violatedPolicies.remediation: Replace ADD with COPY when adding new files to the image. Per https://docs.docker.com/develop/develop-images/dockerfile_best-practices, it is better to use RUN curl instead of ADD if you need to access a URL.

violatedPolicies.name: Alpine Linux Package Manager (apk) in Image

violatedPolicies.name: Curl in Image

violatedPolicies.remediation: Ensure that the deployment manifest has `drop: ALL` in the securityContext section of the container manifest.
